svg.text: Lower beta buys tighter spectrum. Higher beta buys a shorter, more timing-friendly pulse. Matched filtering makes the zero-ISI sampling view visible.
1. Time-domain SRRC pulses for three rolloff values
2. Tx pulse convolved with the matched Rx pulse (beta = 0.35)
Small beta rings longer in time. Large beta settles faster but spends more bandwidth.
Neighboring symbol instants land near zero. The center sample gets the clean decision peak.
